questions.question: Which of the following Harappan sites was not located in Gujarat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Daimabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daimabad **is an archaeological site on the left bank of the **Pravara River**, a tributary of the Godavari River in Srirampur taluka in the **Ahmednagar (**Ahilya Nagar)** district of Maharashtra**.
 
• This site was discovered by** B. P Bopardikar** in 1958.
 
• It has been excavated 3 instances up to now with the aid of using the Archaeological Survey of India teams.
 
• Discoveries at Daimabad recommend that the Late Harappan lifestyle prolonged into the Deccan Plateau in India.
 
• It is well-known for the healing of many bronze goods, a number of which had been motivated with the aid of using the Harappan lifestyle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lothal: 

 
 
• Excavated by S.R Rao in 1953.
 
• It was situated in **Gujarat **on the Bhogva river near the Gulf of Cambay.
 
• Important findings are the first manmade port, dockyard, rice husk, fire altars, chess playing.
 
 
 
• Dholavira:
 
 
• Located on the bank of Luni river in Rann of Kutch, **Gujarat**.
 
• Discovered by JP Joshi (1967-68).
 
• Important finding - Exclusive water management.
 
 
 
• **Surkotada:** 
 
 
• Located between the rivers **Sabarmati **and the **Bhogavo **in **Gujarat**.
 
• Discovered by J.P. Joshi (1966).
 
• Important findings - Horse bone remains, declining Harappan phase.

questions.question: Which of the following IAF Personnel has been posthumously awarded Ashoka Chakra, the country’s highest peace time gallantry medal?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __Jyoti Prakash Nirala.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ashok Chakra for the year 2018 was awarded posthumously to Indian Air Force Garud Commando Corporal Jyoti Prakash Nirala.
 
• Corporal Nirala was killed after he shot down three terrorists in Jammu and Kashmir in 2017.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Ashok Chakra is India's highest peacetime military honour which is awarded for valour, courageous efforts, and self-sacrifice.
 
• The following categories of persons are eligible for the Ashoka Chakra:
 
 
• Men and women of all ranks of the Army, the Navy and the Air Force, any of the Reserve Forces, the Territorial Army, Militia, and any other lawfully constituted forces.
 
• Members of the Nursing Services of the Armed Forces.
 
• Civilian citizens of either sex in all walks of life and members of Police Forces including Central Para-Military Forces and Railway Protection Force.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The order of precedence of gallantry awards is
 
 
• Param Vir Chakra
 
• Ashoka Chakra
 
• Mahavir Chakra
 
• Kirti Chakra
 
• Vir Chakra
 
• Shaurya Chakra

questions.question: What is the ratio of masses of hydrogen and oxygen in the water?
questions.solution: The atomic mass of Hydrogen is 1 u. The atomic mass of oxygen is 16u. Since, there are 2 atoms of hydrogen and 1 atom of oxygen in a water molecule, the ratio of their masses is 2:16 or 1:8.

questions.question: The President of India appoints how many chief election commissioner(s)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**One.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 324(2)**:- The Election Commission shall consist of the Chief Election Commissioner and a such number of other Election Commissioners, if any, as the President may from time to time fix and the appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners shall, subject to the provisions of any law made in that behalf by Parliament, be made by the President.
 
• **There is one** **Chief Election Commissioner who **heads the Election Commission of India.
 
• Along with Chief Election Commissioner, there are **2 other commissioners in the body.**
 
• They all are appointed by **the President of India.**
 
• They are **not eligible for reappointment.**
 
• They have the** same powers as the judges of the Supreme Court.**
 
• It is a body constitutionally empowered to conduct free and fair elections to the national and state legislatures and of President and Vice-President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 324** of the Constitution deals with the Election Commissions.
 
• The tenure of Election Commissioners is** 6 years** or up to **65 years of age**, whichever is earlier

questions.question: The exit of food from the stomach is regulated by a _____ muscle.
questions.solution: A sphincter is a circular muscle that normally maintains constriction of a natural body passage or orifice and which relaxes -as required by normal physiological functioning. Sphincters are found in many animals.

questions.question: What are the organs similar in basic structure/ shape, modified to perform different functions called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Homologous organs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A homologous organ,** system, or body part **that shares a **common ancestry in multiple organisms.**
 
• 
 Homologous organs are **described as the organs of ****various** 

 **animals **with a **similar ****structure**, but with** ****different functions.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Analogous organs-** Analogous organs,** which have identical functions** but distinct origins, are the **opposite of homologous organs.**

 
 
• The wings of** insects, bats, and birds** that **developed independently** in each lineage separately after diverging from an ancestor without wings will be an example of an **analogous trait.**

questions.question: A Sonar of a ship sends sounds waves of speed 1600m/s. These waves are reflected back by the ocean floor in 4 seconds. Find the depth (in m) of the ocean floor.
questions.solution:
Sonar is a technique that uses sound propagation to navigate, communicate or detect. The sonar hydrophones may be towed behind the ship or submarine in order to reduce the effect of noise generated by the watercraft itself.

Given,

Speed = 1600 m/s

time = 4s 

Distance = Speed × Time

 = 1600 × 4 = 6400 m.

Now according to the question statement, These waves are reflected back by the ocean floor in 4 seconds. But this is the total distance traveled by sound. So the depth of the ocean floor is half of the total distance i.e 6400/2 = 3200m.

questions.question: If an object travels in a straight line and its velocity increases or decreases by equal amount in equal intervals of time, then the acceleration of the object is said to be ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option __**2**__ i.e. __**Uniform**__

 
• **Uniform acceleration** is a type of motion in which the velocity of an object changes by an equal amount in every equal time period.
 
• Uniform motion is defined as the motion of an object in which the object travels in a straight line and its velocity remains constant along that line as it covers equal distances in equal intervals of time, irrespective of the length of the time.
